ops.name: glasses.get_context
ops.title: Read glasses context
ops.description: What is on the user's glasses right now: screen, app, title, full screen text, list rows, button legend, lock, media, call and the assistant state.

ops.name: glasses.read_screen
ops.title: Read the glasses screen
ops.description: Text of the current glasses screen (works in image mode too), its list rows with indexes, and what each button does here. grid=true adds the exact character grid.

grid.description: Also return the rendered character grid

ops.name: glasses.press
ops.title: Press a remote button
ops.description: Press a button on the user's glasses remote exactly as they would: y select, b back, x action, a now playing, r notifications, r2 play/pause, l2 quiet (on the assistant), minus lock, plus context action, star apps, heart people, arrows move. Returns the new context.

hold.description: Hold it (~0.6 s) instead of tapping, e.g. b hold = home, plus hold = context menu

times.description: Repeat the tap this many times (default 1)

ops.name: glasses.open_app
ops.title: Open a glasses app
ops.description: Open an app or screen on the glasses. 'home' returns to Home; 'apps' shows the app grid; 'now-playing' the media player; 'calls' the phone call screen.

ops.name: glasses.list_apps
ops.title: List glasses apps
ops.description: The apps on the user's glasses in their order (ids for glasses_open_app), plus the extra screens home, apps, now-playing and calls.

ops.name: glasses.back
ops.title: Go back
ops.description: Go back one screen on the glasses (the B button).

ops.name: glasses.home
ops.title: Go to Home
ops.description: Return the glasses to the Home screen (B hold).

ops.name: glasses.select_row
ops.title: Pick a list row
ops.description: On a list screen, pick a row by index (from glasses_read_screen) or by label, then open it (Y, default), run its action (X) or just focus it.

label.description: Row label (case-insensitive; exact match first, then contains)

ops.name: glasses.type_text
ops.title: Type into the glasses
ops.description: Send text where the user would dictate on the current screen (e.g. a Beeper thread sends a message, a T3 thread a prompt). glasses_read_screen's canType says what it does. mode=steer steers a running T3 turn.

text.description: The text, exactly as it should be sent

ops.name: glasses.lock
ops.title: Lock the glasses
ops.description: Lock the glasses (blank display; the remote only unlocks), like a minus tap.

ops.name: glasses.unlock
ops.title: Unlock the glasses
ops.description: Unlock the glasses and show the current screen again.

ops.name: glasses.show_toast
ops.title: Flash a message
ops.description: Flash a short message on the glasses for about two seconds.

ops.name: glasses.list_operations
ops.title: List glasses operations
ops.description: Every glasses operation (including ones not offered as tools), with risk and whether it can run right now. Run any of them with glasses_run.

app.description: Only this app (e.g. beeper, joy, glasses)

ops.name: glasses.run
ops.title: Run a glasses operation
ops.description: Run any glasses operation by name (see glasses_list_operations), including ones that are not separate tools. Confirmation follows the target operation.

ops.name: home.summary
ops.title: Read the Home summary
ops.description: What the user's glasses Home screen summarises: weather, next event, Beeper unread chats, T3 threads needing them, now playing, notifications, call and passive listening.

ops.name: joy.read_reply
ops.title: Read the assistant's glasses reply
ops.description: The conversation currently on the glasses assistant screen: status, the last prompt and the assistant's last reply text.

ops.name: joy.new_conversation
ops.title: Start a new assistant conversation
ops.description: Start a fresh glasses conversation with the assistant (the next glasses message begins a new session).

ops.name: joy.set_quiet
ops.title: Set assistant quiet wait
ops.description: Quiet wait on: the assistant's glasses replies arrive as a notification instead of taking over the screen (the L2 toggle).

ops.name: joy.start_voice_call
ops.title: Start an assistant voice call
ops.description: Start a live voice call with the assistant on the glasses (uses the microphone).

ops.name: joy.end_voice_call
ops.title: End the assistant voice call
ops.description: Hang up the live assistant voice call.

ops.name: beeper.list_chats
ops.title: List Beeper chats
ops.description: The user's Beeper chats, unread first: id, name, network, unread count, counts (on the unread badge), muted, mentions, spam and the last message.

unread_only.description: Only chats on the unread badge (unread, not muted unless @mentioned, not spam)

include_spam.description: Also list chats marked spam (default false)

ops.name: beeper.read_chat
ops.title: Read a Beeper chat
ops.description: The latest messages of one chat (id or name), oldest first, with message ids for reply_to and beeper_react. Does not mark it read.

ops.name: beeper.open_chat
ops.title: Open a Beeper chat
ops.description: Show one chat's thread on the glasses (newest message focused), e.g. so the user can read or answer it himself.

ops.name: beeper.send_message
ops.title: Send Beeper message
ops.description: Send a text message to one of the user's chats (id or name). reply_to quotes a message id from beeper_read_chat. mentions maps an @token in the text to a participant id (from dictation); without ids @Name goes as plain text.

text.description: Message text, exactly as it should be sent

mentions.description: Optional {"@Token": participant id} for each @mention in the text

ops.name: beeper.react
ops.title: React to a Beeper message
ops.description: Add (or remove) an emoji reaction on a message (id from beeper_read_chat). On the assistant's approval prompts, ✅ approves and ❌ cancels.

ops.name: beeper.mark_read
ops.title: Mark a Beeper chat read
ops.description: Mark one chat read (it leaves the unread badge), as opening it on the glasses does.

ops.name: beeper.mark_spam
ops.title: Mark a Beeper chat spam
ops.description: Mark one chat as spam: it stops counting as unread and its notifications stay quiet. Stored in the gateway only; Beeper is not told.

ops.name: beeper.mark_not_spam
ops.title: Mark a Beeper chat not spam
ops.description: Undo spam for one chat (also overrides the automatic spam filter for it).

ops.name: t3.list_threads
ops.title: List T3 threads
ops.description: The user's T3 Code threads across machines: machine, id, title, project, provider, status (input/approval/request/limited/failed need the user; working; done), age and current step.

ops.name: t3.read_thread
ops.title: Read a T3 thread
ops.description: One thread in full: status, the agent's latest message, a pending request (approval command, or questions with option labels), the working step and recent history.

machine.description: Machine id, when the thread id is not unique

ops.name: t3.open_thread
ops.title: Open a T3 thread
ops.description: Show one T3 thread on the glasses (its current view: working, approval, question or latest message).

machine.description: Machine id, when the thread id is not unique

ops.name: t3.send_message
ops.title: Send to a T3 thread
ops.description: Send a prompt to a T3 thread. A running thread queues it for after the turn unless mode is steer (redirects the running turn). /glasses is added so replies come back short.

machine.description: Machine id, when the thread id is not unique

text.description: The prompt, exactly as it should be sent

mode.description: send (default; queues while running), queue or steer

ops.name: t3.respond
ops.title: Answer a T3 request
ops.description: Answer a thread's pending request. Approval: decision approve, approve_for_thread or deny. Questions: choice (one question) or answers {question id: option label, number, list or free text}.

machine.description: Machine id, when the thread id is not unique

decision.description: For an approval: approve (once), approve_for_thread or deny

choice.description: For a single question: the option label or number, or a free-text answer

answers.description: For several questions: question id -> option label, option number, list of labels (multi) or free text

ops.name: t3.new_thread
ops.title: Start a T3 thread
ops.description: Start a new T3 Code thread in a project (name or id; t3.list_projects via glasses_run lists them) with a first prompt. It starts a real agent run, then opens on the glasses.

machine.description: Machine id or label, when the project exists on several

open.description: Open the new thread on the glasses (default true)

ops.name: t3.usage
ops.title: Read T3 usage
ops.description: Coding-agent usage per provider and machine: each limit window's used percent, reset time and pace, plus available usage-reset credits.

ops.name: t3.list_machines
ops.title: List T3 machines
ops.description: The user's T3 machines (environments): id, label, online, OS, last seen, whether the assistant can write there, and pairing problems.

ops.name: t3.list_projects
ops.title: List T3 projects
ops.description: Projects a new T3 thread can start in: id, name and machine.

ops.name: t3.use_reset
ops.title: Use a T3 usage reset
ops.description: Spend one usage-reset credit (ids from t3_usage) to reset a provider's limits now.

ops.name: media.now_playing
ops.title: Read now playing
ops.description: What is playing on the user's phone or Spotify: source (spotify, abs audiobook, youtube, phone), title, artist, playing, position, device, volume and speed.

ops.name: media.play
ops.title: Resume playback
ops.description: Resume whatever was playing (Spotify, an audiobook or the phone's media app).

ops.name: media.pause
ops.title: Pause playback
ops.description: Pause playback.

ops.name: media.next
ops.title: Next track
ops.description: Skip to the next track (Spotify or the phone's media app).

ops.name: media.previous
ops.title: Previous track
ops.description: Go back to the previous track.

ops.name: media.rewind
ops.title: Rewind
ops.description: Jump back in an audiobook or video (default 30 s, like the remote).

ops.name: media.forward
ops.title: Skip forward
ops.description: Jump forward in an audiobook or video (default 30 s, like the remote).

ops.name: media.set_speed
ops.title: Set playback speed
ops.description: Playback speed for audiobooks and videos (the glasses offer 1, 1.25, 1.5, 1.75 and 2). Not for Spotify.

ops.name: media.set_volume
ops.title: Set media volume
ops.description: Media volume, 0 to 15 (the remote's R2 + up/down steps). Spotify Connect devices use their own volume.

ops.name: media.list_spotify
ops.title: List Spotify playlists
ops.description: The Spotify lists the glasses offer: Discover Weekly, Liked Songs, recent playlists and the library, with uris for media_play_spotify.

ops.name: media.play_spotify
ops.title: Play on Spotify
ops.description: Play a Spotify list: liked=true for Liked Songs, playlist by name or uri, or query to match the user's playlists by name (catalog search is not available). device picks the Connect device.

playlist.description: Playlist name or spotify: uri (e.g. Discover Weekly)

query.description: Words to match against the user's playlist names

device.description: Spotify Connect device id or name (see media.list_devices)

ops.name: media.list_devices
ops.title: List Spotify devices
ops.description: Spotify Connect devices (id, name, active) for media.transfer and media_play_spotify.

ops.name: media.transfer
ops.title: Move Spotify playback
ops.description: Move Spotify playback to another Connect device (id or name).

ops.name: media.list_audiobooks
ops.title: List audiobooks
ops.description: The user's recently played, unfinished audiobooks (Audiobookshelf): id, title, author, chapter, progress.

ops.name: media.play_audiobook
ops.title: Play an audiobook
ops.description: Play an audiobook by title or id (see media.list_audiobooks) from where the user left off. Without book, resumes the current or most recent book.

ops.name: media.list_youtube
ops.title: List YouTube videos
ops.description: Videos in the YouTube list for media_play_youtube: id, title, channel, duration.

ops.name: media.play_youtube
ops.title: Play a YouTube video
ops.description: Play a video from the YouTube list (id or title from media_list_youtube) on the phone; Now Playing shows it.

ops.name: notifications.list
ops.title: List glasses notifications
ops.description: The glasses Notifications list, most important first: id, app, title, text, importance, route (stream or popup), age and whether it opens an app.

ops.name: notifications.open
ops.title: Open a notification
ops.description: Open a notification in its app on the glasses (Beeper thread, T3 thread, calendar day...), as Y does; the notification is then cleared.

id.description: Notification id (see notifications_list) or part of its title

ops.name: notifications.dismiss
ops.title: Dismiss a notification
ops.description: Remove one notification from the glasses list (X). The message or chat in the source app is not touched.

id.description: Notification id (see notifications_list) or part of its title

ops.name: notifications.clear
ops.title: Clear all notifications
ops.description: Clear the whole glasses Notifications list, including missed calls. Source apps are not touched.

ops.name: contacts.search
ops.title: Search contacts
ops.description: Find people in the user's phone contacts by name, nickname or relationship ("mom"). Returns names, number labels and numbers (masked unless reveal_numbers).

reveal_numbers.description: Full numbers; only when the user asked for a number

ops.name: call.place
ops.title: Place a phone call
ops.description: Call a contact (name, nickname like "mom", or contact_id) or a number from the user's phone. Ambiguous names return candidates instead of calling. The user may have to confirm on the glasses.

contact.description: Contact name, nickname/relationship, or contact_id from contacts_search

number.description: Phone number to dial (instead of contact)

label.description: Which number: mobile, home, work, main, other

route.description: Audio: bluetooth (default when connected), earpiece, speaker, wired, or a device name

ops.name: call.answer
ops.title: Answer the ringing call
ops.description: Answer the phone call that is ringing now (see call_state).

ops.name: call.decline
ops.title: Decline the ringing call
ops.description: Decline (reject) the phone call that is ringing now.

ops.name: call.hangup
ops.title: Hang up the call
ops.description: End the current phone call (or a call by id).

ops.name: call.mute
ops.title: Mute or unmute the call
ops.description: Mute (on=true) or unmute the user's microphone on the current phone call.

ops.name: call.routes
ops.title: List call audio routes
ops.description: Audio devices the current call can use (earbuds, handset, speaker, car, wired) and which is current.

ops.name: call.route
ops.title: Switch call audio
ops.description: Move the current call's audio: bluetooth, earpiece/handset, speaker, wired, a device name or a route id from call_routes.

endpoint.description: Route kind, device name or id

ops.name: call.recents
ops.title: Read recent calls
ops.description: The user's recent calls from the phone's call log, newest first: name, kind (missed, in, out...), when, duration.

reveal_numbers.description: Full numbers; only when the user asked for a number

ops.name: call.state
ops.title: Read phone call state
ops.description: Current phone calls (ringing, dialing, active, held), mute, audio route and which call permissions the phone has.

reveal_numbers.description: Full numbers; only when the user asked for a number

ops.name: timer.start
ops.title: Start a timer
ops.description: Start a countdown timer on the user's glasses; it rings on the phone and glasses.

ops.name: timer.list
ops.title: List timers
ops.description: Running and paused timers (glasses and phone clock) and anything ringing.

ops.name: timer.pause
ops.title: Pause a timer
ops.description: Pause a running timer.

id.description: Timer id or label from timer_list (default: the soonest)

ops.name: timer.resume
ops.title: Resume a timer
ops.description: Resume a paused timer.

id.description: Timer id or label from timer_list (default: the soonest)

ops.name: timer.cancel
ops.title: Cancel a timer
ops.description: Cancel a timer, or all timers with all=true.

id.description: Timer id or label from timer_list (default: the soonest)

ops.name: timer.add_time
ops.title: Add time to a timer
ops.description: Add (or with a leading minus remove) time from a timer, e.g. "5m" or "-1m".

id.description: Timer id or label from timer_list (default: the soonest)

ops.name: stopwatch.start
ops.title: Start the stopwatch
ops.description: Start (or continue) the glasses stopwatch.

ops.name: stopwatch.stop
ops.title: Stop the stopwatch
ops.description: Stop the stopwatch, keeping its time and laps.

ops.name: stopwatch.lap
ops.title: Mark a lap
ops.description: Mark a lap on the running stopwatch.

ops.name: stopwatch.reset
ops.title: Reset the stopwatch
ops.description: Reset the stopwatch to 0 and clear its laps.

ops.name: stopwatch.state
ops.title: Read the stopwatch
ops.description: Stopwatch elapsed time, running state and laps.

ops.name: alarm.set
ops.title: Set an alarm
ops.description: Set (or with id, edit) a glasses alarm. It rings on the phone and glasses.

days.description: Repeat: "once" (default), "daily", "weekdays", "weekends" or days like "mon wed fri"

ops.name: alarm.list
ops.title: List alarms
ops.description: Glasses alarms, the phone clock's next alarm and anything ringing.

ops.name: alarm.delete
ops.title: Delete an alarm
ops.description: Delete a glasses alarm (id, time or label).

id.description: Alarm id, time or label (see alarm_list)

ops.name: alarm.enable
ops.title: Turn an alarm on or off
ops.description: Turn a glasses alarm on or off.

ops.name: alarm.dismiss
ops.title: Stop what is ringing
ops.description: Stop a ringing alarm or timer (default: everything ringing). For an alarm id that is not ringing, skips its next occurrence.

ops.name: alarm.snooze
ops.title: Snooze
ops.description: Snooze the ringing alarm (a ringing timer gets +1 min).

ops.name: alarm.phone_list
ops.title: List phone clock alarms
ops.description: EXPERIMENTAL. The user's Google Clock alarms on the phone (time, label, days, on/off). Cached; refresh=true re-reads them by briefly opening Google Clock (phone must be unlocked).

refresh.description: Re-read from Google Clock now (default false: last read list)

ops.name: alarm.phone_toggle
ops.title: Switch a phone clock alarm
ops.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Turn one of the user's existing Google Clock alarms on or off by time (and label when several share a time). Briefly opens Google Clock on the unlocked phone and verifies the switch.

label.description: Alarm label, when several alarms share the time

ops.name: people.recent
ops.title: List recent people
ops.description: Known people the glasses heard in the last 10 minutes and recently seen people (where and when), with ids. heard is empty while passive listening is off.

ops.name: people.lookup
ops.title: Look up a person
ops.description: One known person's card: where and when last seen, and the user's notes about them (id or name).

ops.name: people.mute
ops.title: Mute a person
ops.description: Mute (or unmute) a person: muted people are not announced when heard and leave the recent list.

ops.name: people.open
ops.title: Show a person's card
ops.description: Show one person's card (notes) on the glasses.

ops.name: health.overview
ops.title: Read health overview
ops.description: The user's latest health metrics (readiness, sleep, activity, HRV, resting heart rate, weight...): value, when measured and the breakdown rows.

ops.name: health.metric_history
ops.title: Read a metric's history
ops.description: Daily values of one metric (key or name, or a breakdown row such as deep sleep) over the last N days, oldest first, with min, max and average.

ops.name: health.open_metric
ops.title: Show a health chart
ops.description: Show one metric's chart on the glasses, 7 or 30 days.

ops.name: calendar.agenda
ops.title: Read the agenda
ops.description: The user's calendar for the next N days (today first): each day's date and events with time, title, location and whether all-day. Multi-day events list on each day.

ops.name: calendar.open_day
ops.title: Show a calendar day
ops.description: Open the glasses calendar with the cursor on one day's first event (today, tomorrow, a weekday or YYYY-MM-DD).

day.description: today, tomorrow, a weekday (friday) or YYYY-MM-DD

ops.name: report.latest
ops.title: Read the morning report
ops.description: The latest morning report on the glasses: its date, whether it is today's or stale, and every card (type, heading, body).

ops.name: report.open
ops.title: Open the morning report
ops.description: Open the morning report on the glasses, at the first card or at one card (heading or type, e.g. weather, calendar, news).

ops.name: ha.panel
ops.title: Read Home Assistant
ops.description: The user's Home Assistant panel: scenes (id, name), the wake-up alarm (time, style) and 3D printers (state, progress, time left, detail).

ops.name: ha.run_scene
ops.title: Run a Home Assistant scene
ops.description: Run one Home Assistant scene (id or name from ha_panel), e.g. lights for guests or going to sleep.

ops.name: ha.set_alarm
ops.title: Set the wake-up alarm
ops.description: Set the user's Home Assistant wake-up alarm time ("7:00 AM") and/or style (Gentle or Harsh).

ops.name: docs.list
ops.title: List glasses docs
ops.description: Documents in the glasses Docs app, newest first: id, title, created time and length.

ops.name: docs.read
ops.title: Read a glasses doc
ops.description: The text of one document (id or title).

ops.name: docs.open
ops.title: Open a glasses doc
ops.description: Open one document in the glasses reader (first page) so the user can read it.

ops.name: docs.scroll
ops.title: Page the open doc
ops.description: Turn pages in the document open on the glasses (positive = forward, negative = back).

ops.name: memo.list
ops.title: List voice memos
ops.description: Whether a voice memo is recording (and for how long) plus recent memos: id, title, time, length and upload/transcription state.

ops.name: memo.read
ops.title: Read a voice memo
ops.description: One memo's transcript (id or title from memo_list). Empty until the gateway has transcribed it.

ops.name: memo.start
ops.title: Start a voice memo
ops.description: Start recording a voice memo with the glasses microphone (as tapping L on the memo screen). Stop it with memo_stop.

ops.name: memo.stop
ops.title: Stop the voice memo
ops.description: Stop the voice memo that is recording; it is saved and sent for transcription.

ops.name: memo.toggle
ops.title: Start or stop a voice memo
ops.description: Start a voice memo, or stop the one recording (the memo shortcut).

ops.name: teleprompter.read_script
ops.title: Read the teleprompter script
ops.description: The teleprompter script text, and whether the teleprompter is open and auto-scrolling.

ops.name: teleprompter.open
ops.title: Open the teleprompter
ops.description: Open the teleprompter at the top of the script, paused.

ops.name: teleprompter.start
ops.title: Start the teleprompter
ops.description: Open the teleprompter (if needed) and start auto-scrolling the script; the display stays lit while it scrolls.

ops.name: teleprompter.stop
ops.title: Pause the teleprompter
ops.description: Pause teleprompter auto-scrolling (the script stays where it is).

ops.name: teleprompter.scroll
ops.title: Scroll the teleprompter
ops.description: Move the open teleprompter script by lines (negative = back).

ops.name: status.read
ops.title: Read glasses status
ops.description: Battery levels (glasses, earbuds by name, Oura, phone), Wi-Fi, cell signal, glasses link and brightness, as on the Status screen.

ops.name: status.list_bluetooth_devices
ops.title: List Bluetooth devices
ops.description: Paired Bluetooth devices with kind, whether connected, battery, and the Status screen setting (auto, show, hide).

ops.name: status.set_bluetooth_device
ops.title: Choose a Status device
ops.description: Show or hide one Bluetooth device's battery on the Status screen; auto shows earbuds and headphones only.

ops.name: settings.read
ops.title: Read glasses settings
ops.description: Display & sleep (sleep after, dim, first press, Home after lock, popups when locked, look-up wake, dark mode), head gestures, display position, brightness and app order.

ops.name: settings.set_display_power
ops.title: Change display & sleep
ops.description: Set any of: sleep_after_s (display timeout, 0 = never), dim_first, first_press_acts, home_after_lock_s (0 = off), popups, popup_s, popups_when_locked, look_up (ON/OFF/TOGGLE/NOTHING), look_up_when_locked, text_case, memo_keeps_lit, joy_call_layout, dark_mode.

sleep_after_s.description: Idle seconds before the lens goes dark: 0 (never), 5, 10, 12, 15, 20, 30 or 60

first_press_acts.description: A press that wakes the lens also acts

home_after_lock_s.description: Unlocking after this long opens Home: 0 (off), 30, 60 or 300

popups_when_locked.description: Important popups light a locked lens

wake_on_look_up.description: Old switch: true = look_up ON, false = NOTHING

look_up_when_locked.description: Looking up also acts while the glasses are locked

text_case.description: Glasses text: CAPS (all caps) or NORMAL

popups.description: Important notifications pop up and light the lens

popup_s.description: Seconds a popup stays up: 4, 6, 8, 10 or 15

memo_keeps_lit.description: A recording memo keeps the lens lit

ops.name: settings.set_head_gestures
ops.title: Change head gestures
ops.description: Set the glasses' look-up wake angle (10 to 70 degrees), nod/shake answers, and which gesture confirms.

look_up_angle.description: Look-up angle in degrees, 10 to 70 in steps of 5

ops.name: settings.set_display_position
ops.title: Change display position
ops.description: Set where the image sits (height high, middle or low) and its depth (distance near or far) on the glasses.

ops.name: shortcuts.list
ops.title: List controller shortcuts
ops.description: Each assignable controller gesture (id, label), its assigned app action, the actions it can take, and the apps that keep that button for themselves.

ops.name: shortcuts.assign
ops.title: Assign a controller shortcut
ops.description: Give a controller gesture (e.g. l2.hold) an app action id or label from shortcuts_list, or action "none" to clear it.

gesture.description: Gesture id or label, e.g. l2.hold or Hold L2

action.description: Action id or label (e.g. memo.toggle), or none

ops.name: lifelog.status
ops.title: Read lifelog capture status
ops.description: Whether passive listening (ambient conversation capture and voice matching) is on, and today's capture state, recorded time and conversations.

ops.name: lifelog.pause
ops.title: Pause passive listening
ops.description: Stop ambient capture and voice matching now (the minus-hold switch). Dictation, memos and calls still work.

ops.name: lifelog.resume
ops.title: Resume passive listening
ops.description: Turn passive listening back on (ambient capture and voice matching).
